code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, and relative neutropenia and lymphopenia, with mild basophilia and eosinophilia. Chloride is slightly elevated. Liver and kidney function, glucose, and electrolytes are otherwise within normal limits. Findings suggest possible bone marrow suppression or systemic illness; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
